A Capacity Is a Dimension Whose Transit Is the Demand
The Search Does Not Prove That a Fleet Is Too Small

gates.says: all 3 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-span: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-span: The global span is "the largest cumul at any vehicle's end minus the smallest cumul at any vehicle's start. Every start is 0 here, so the span is the longest route": 50 × 70.
recorded.prompt:q-cumul: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-cumul: "The cumul is the value on arrival ... So the cumul at a stop is everything picked up before it". Only A's 4 is picked up before B.
recorded.prompt:q-short-fleet: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-short-fleet: "a heuristic that finds nothing has not proved there is nothing to find". ROUTING_FAIL_TIMEOUT means "time limit reached before finding a solution", not proven infeasible.

recorded.prompt:q-span:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-span:a: The span is the largest end cumul minus the smallest start cumul, not the sum of the routes.
recorded.prompt:q-span:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-span:b: "minus the smallest cumul at any vehicle's start", which is 0 here, not the shortest route.
recorded.prompt:q-span:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-span:d: "it changes the objective only if you ask. SetGlobalSpanCostCoefficient(100) asks: it adds 100 times the global span".
recorded.prompt:q-cumul:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-cumul:b: "the transit of a stop is added on the arc that leaves it", so B's demand is not in B's cumul.
recorded.prompt:q-cumul:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-cumul:c: The cumul at a stop is "everything picked up before it", not the stop's own demand.
recorded.prompt:q-cumul:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-cumul:d: "the cumul at the end is the route's whole load". It grows along the route and is not fixed at every stop.
recorded.prompt:q-short-fleet:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-short-fleet:a: ROUTING_FAIL_TIMEOUT means "time limit reached before finding a solution", "not 'proven infeasible'".
recorded.prompt:q-short-fleet:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-short-fleet:b: The page's own example got ROUTING_FAIL_TIMEOUT for a fleet that truly cannot fit (24 kits for 33). The status does not show that routes exist.
recorded.prompt:q-short-fleet:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-short-fleet:c: The timeout is not proof that the fleet is too small. The page advises checking the arithmetic first, or making visits optional.
